messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up  found inconsistent embeddings examples across the API reference and generated SDK snippets. The curl in the quickstart uses a raw array, which confuses users. Example currently:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '[\"a\",\"b\"]'
```
It should be the object form for batch calls:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"input": ["a","b"]}'
```

Ivy: Thanks. Which PR/file is this?

Sam: PR #5012, file docs/reference/embeddings.md. Also the generated Python and Ruby snippets differ: Python shows client.embeddings.create(["x","y"]) in one place and client.embeddings.create(input=["x","y"]) in another.

Ravi: Yep saw that too. The OpenAPI examples currently have both shapes in different example blocks, so the snippet generator flips depending on which example it picks. We need a canonical example in the OpenAPI spec: always use {"input": [...] } for batch and a separate example for single string.

Nora: docs-bot already posted the CI failure this morning: examples-lint failed on example_request_shape.

docs-bot: PR #5012  examples-lint  failed: example_request_shape mismatch in docs/reference/embeddings.md. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/5012/logs

Ivy: Plan: Sam/Ravi  Sam can you open a tiny PR to fix the curl + quickstart examples in the docs, and Ravi can update the OpenAPI example and regen snippets so SDK docs align? I'll add a short migration blurb for customers who copied the old array form.

Sam: On it. I'll submit a small change to the docs page (curl + codeblock) and add a one-line NOTE: "Batch requests must use {\"input\": [...] }. Single-input examples shown separately." Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5017

Ravi: I'll update specs/openapi/embeddings.yaml to make the primary example the object shape and add an explicit single-string example under examples.single. Then I'll run the snippet generator and push updated language examples.

Nora: Can we also add a lightweight examples-lint rule that scans code blocks for embeddings endpoints and asserts the request JSON uses "input" for batch payloads? That'll prevent regressions.

Ravi: Good idea. I can add a unit test in examples-lint harness (should be tiny): parse example JSON and assert top-level array not allowed for /v1/embeddings POST.

docs-bot: PR #5017 opened by Sam  docs quickfix for curl and quickstart examples. CI pending.

Sam: Local preview shows the updated quickstart renders correctly and the curl example returned 200 against staging when I used the object payload.

docs-bot: PR #5017  CI passed and merged.

Ivy: Thanks all. Ravi, once your OpenAPI fix and regen PR lands, I'll bump the docs changelog: "docs(embeddings): standardize batch vs single examples; clarify request shape" and we can close this issue.

Ravi: Putting the OpenAPI PR up next. Will include the examples-lint test in the same PR.

Sam: Resolving on the docs tracker after Ravi's PR merges. :white_check_mark:
